title: Watch: Belgium make light work of US to set up quarter-final tie with Spain
originalTitle: Watch: Belgium make light work of US to set up quarter-final tie with Spain
content:
Belgium ease past a defensively sloppy United States in a match shrouded in controversy surrounding the delayed suspension of co-hosts' striker Folarin Balogun.
